import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

for name, fname in [('obs1', '/work/observations/obs_0001.png'),
                    ('obs3', '/work/observations/obs_0003.png'),
                    ('obs5', '/work/observations/obs_0005.png')]:
    arr = np.array(Image.open(fname).convert('RGB'))
    print(f'=== {name} ===')
    # find where wall meets ceiling and wall meets floor at various columns
    for col in [100, 200, 256, 300, 400]:
        # find ceiling edge (dark to white)
        dark = arr[:, col, 0] < 50
        floor = (arr[:, col, 0] > 100) & (arr[:, col, 0] < 200) & (arr[:, col, 1] > 100) & (arr[:, col, 1] < 200)
        # find transitions
        ceil_y = np.where(dark)[0][-1] if np.any(dark) else None
        floor_y = np.where(floor)[0][0] if np.any(floor) else None
        print(f'col {col}: ceil_y={ceil_y}, floor_y={floor_y}')
"
